response.sql:
WITH units AS (
  SELECT 
    tr.transreg,
    tr.ordertypedist,
    AVG(sf.instownpct) as unit_ownership
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals sf
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON sf.transref = tr.transreg
  WHERE tr.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY tr.transreg, tr.ordertypedist
),
mix_baselines AS (
  SELECT 
    ordertypedist,
    AVG(unit_ownership) as mix_baseline
  FROM units
  GROUP BY ordertypedist
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(unit_ownership) as overall_average
  FROM units
),
kept_units AS (
  SELECT 
    u.unit_ownership,
    m.mix_baseline,
    (SELECT overall_average FROM overall_avg) as overall_average
  FROM units u
  INNER JOIN mix_baselines m ON u.ordertypedist = m.ordertypedist
  WHERE u.unit_ownership > (SELECT overall_average FROM overall_avg)
)
SELECT
  AVG(unit_ownership) as avg_kept_ownership,
  AVG(unit_ownership / mix_baseline) as avg_ratio_to_baseline,
  AVG(unit_ownership - overall_average) as avg_excess_over_overall
FROM kept_units

assumptions.assumption: instownpct NULL values are ignored when averaging unit ownership (standard SQL AVG behavior).
If all units fall at or below the overall average, kept_units is empty and the output metrics are NULL.
